title: Gripper jaws: opening check
description: The compliant jaws' three pieces moved apart so the horn's opening can be swept: the palm with its root blocks, stops and posts, and each jaw on a slide that follows the servo by how far the horn pushes it. The real part is one print, at rest; this is the check, not the build. The flexures model (gripperJawsModel) gives the grip, the springs, the stops and the strain.
